title: Terrain
source: CMap's `terrain_definition` key names the file; CMap's vftable slot 5 parses it (project.json, CMap 0x11BE3EC). A category is a CTerrain, whose LoadKey (0xADA10) names 12 keys; a drawn terrain is a CTerrainGraphical, whose LoadKey (0xAE7E0) names 8 (FINDINGS-definitions.md). The top level - `terrain`, `categories`, and a drawn terrain per palette index of terrain.bmp (FINDINGS-movement.md section 6) - was not read and comes from usage. The names plains, mountain, urban, desert and arctic are tested by the engine (CTerrain::CTerrain).

file.desc: terrain categories, then the drawn terrains of terrain.bmp

terrain.desc: how many drawn terrains there are (256)

categories.desc: the terrain types a province may be

patterns.desc: a drawn terrain: which category one palette index of terrain.bmp is, and how it is drawn
a terrain type; plains, mountain, urban, desert and arctic are tested by name by the engine

movement_cost.desc: cost of a pixel of it on the walk that measures a province edge; used only when the map cache is rebuilt (FINDINGS-movement.md section 6)

attack.desc: combat modifier for attacking into it

defence.desc: combat modifier for defending in it

attacker.desc: a key of CTerrain's switch; its value was not read

defender.desc: a key of CTerrain's switch; its value was not read

humidity.desc: humidity; decides what counts as jungle (FINDINGS-weather.md)

color.desc: the palette index or indices of terrain.bmp it stands for

has_texture.desc: whether it has a texture of its own
